note: Held-out sentences for the Live head's Save My Soul (SOS) tool selection. Never copy any of these into a tool description, instruction.py, or agent.yaml: the well-formedness test fails when one appears there. A follow_up id containing '-active-' runs against a world with a live alert so its history can prepare a stop card.
